Nora P: opened a tiny PR to fix wording and add one SDK snippet for the model-catalog entry for 'glacier4b-compact'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/478
Sam T: quick — what changed?
Nora P: summary: 1) clarify supported quant profiles (q4_1 only for compact build), 2) correct max sequence for compact to 24576 (was 32768 in doc), 3) replace broken bench CSV link, 4) add SDK snippet showing embeddings vs text generation usage and truncate note.
Sam T: paste snippet?
Nora P: snippet:
```python
# embeddings: explicit truncate for long docs
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model=\"glacier4b-compact\", input=[long_text], truncate=True)
# text generation example (streaming)
with client.texts.stream(model=\"glacier4b-compact\") as s:
    s.add("Summarize the following report")
    for part in s.receive():
        print(part.text, end="")
```
bench-bot: new CSV uploaded: https://bench.redwood.ai/2026/glacier4b-compact-summary.csv
docs-bot: docs CI linkcheck passed :white_check_mark:
